svg.text: Color tokens, contrast ratios (WCAG 2.2 AA), bilingual typography scale, spacing units, and responsive layout grids
01. Semantic Color Tokens & WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Ratios
Usage: Monumental architectural headlines only. Never used for body text.
BANGLA PRIMARY DISPLAY & UI — Noto Sans Bengali
• Body text: 18px / 1.75 line-height (room for Bengali ascenders/descenders)
Rule: Never letter-space or italicize Bangla; maintain natural conjuncts.
Thoughtful interiors shaped around your everyday family life and budget.
• Body: 18px / 1.6 line-height / Weight 400 (45-70 characters per line max, max-width 640px)
Radius Tokens: Media = 0px (strict architectural squared edges), Controls = 2px, Overlays = 4px max.
03. Spacing Scale, Radius Tokens & Responsive Layout Grids
Spacing Tokens (8px Base Scale with 4px Subdivisions):
• 12 Columns, Max Content Width: 1312px, Outer Gutters: 64px, Column Gap: 24px
• Asymmetrical 7/5 and 5/7 column project spreads for architectural rhythm
Header: 88px tall, solid paper surface, no translucent blur
Section spacing: 112-144px between major story blocks
• Two-column cards collapse to balanced 4/4 or stacked 8-col blocks
Header: 80px tall, compact navigation or drawer trigger
• Single column stacking: Title + CTA on paper BEFORE hero image
Header: 72px tall, full touch target Menu trigger (48px)
Persistent bottom contact bar: Call + WhatsApp (hidden on form & menu)
